title: Quantum Dynamic Scheduling Policy
description: Configuration schema for the QSplit quantum dynamic scheduling policy. This policy selects execution locations based on the number of running jobs per provider and optional usage penalties.

targetProvider.description: Map each deployment or location name to a logical provider identifier. Keys are the names of deployments defined in streamflow.yml or the names of AvailableLocation objects.

fallbackCost.description: Cost assigned to a location when a provider cannot be identified. Lower values mean higher priority. Defaults to a very large number.

maxConcurrentJobs.description: Maximum number of running jobs that can be concurrently allocated to a single location. A value of 0 or absence of this field means unlimited concurrency.

usagePenalty.description: Penalty added per previous selection of a provider to discourage sticking to a single backend.
